headline: Gold Holds Near One-Year Low Amid Firm Dollar and Fed Policy Bets
summary: Spot gold traded steadily near $3,856 per ounce, remaining close to a one-year low as strong US dollar performance and interest rate hike expectations limited demand.
why: Gold is a financial safe-haven asset whose price generally moves inversely to real interest rates and the strength of the US dollar.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Higher yield expectations and a strong US currency reduced investor demand for bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Continued strength in the US dollar and elevated interest rate bets maintained pressure on precious metals.
